job.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
job.workplace: Hybrid – in the office 2 days a week
job.pay_full: $180,000 – $247,500 a year base salary (California outside the SF Bay Area, Colorado, Illinois, New York and Washington), plus equity where applicable and bonus

details.about: Okta is an identity company that secures access for people and AI. This role joins Okta's ISPM team, which builds highly reliable, scalable and secure cloud services with an automation-first mindset and steady investment in platform engineering, observability and operational excellence. As a Staff SRE you'll be a technical leader in the ISPM SRE organization, working closely with software engineers, architects and product teams.
duties: Architect, build and operate mission-critical cloud infrastructure and production services at scale
Lead frontline incident response in a 24/7 on-call rotation and own post-incident reviews end to end, fixing root causes
Define and improve SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
Influence architecture to improve availability, scalability, performance and resilience
Build observability: metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards and alerting
Develop software, automation and infrastructure with Go, Python and Terraform, and cut operational toil
Improve deployment safety with CI/CD and GitOps, and build self-service platforms and guardrails
Lead reliability initiatives across multiple teams and mentor engineers through design reviews and incident analysis
Explore AI-assisted engineering to improve incident response, troubleshooting and automation
needs: Strong experience operating large-scale production services in AWS and/or GCP
Deep production expertise with Kubernetes, including troubleshooting networking, storage, scheduling, scaling and workload lifecycle issues
Extensive Infrastructure as Code experience with tools such as Terraform and Helm
Strong software engineering skills in Go and/or Python, and experience building automation and internal platforms
Experience operating distributed data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, MySQL or MongoDB
Strong grasp of cloud networking: DNS, load balancing, ingress, TLS, service networking and traffic management
Experience with observability platforms and production telemetry
Experience leading incident response; deep understanding of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and capacity planning; CI/CD and deployment strategies
Understanding of cloud security fundamentals, IAM, secrets management and secure infrastructure design
A track record of leading complex initiatives across teams, mentoring engineers and working in globally distributed organizations
Experience with, or strong interest in, AI-assisted engineering and operational automation
nice: Operating SaaS platforms with large-scale customer workloads
Implementing AI-assisted operational tooling or automation workflows
Operational controls in regulated or security-sensitive environments
details.benefits: Base salary $180,000 – $247,500 a year for candidates in California (excluding the San Francisco Bay Area), Colorado, Illinois, New York and Washington; actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience and work location. Okta also offers equity (where applicable), bonus, and benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), a flexible spending account and paid leave, including PTO and parental leave.
notes: Hybrid: in the office 2 days a week
In-person onboarding in San Francisco, CA during the first week
Tech stack includes Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, Helm, AWS, Airflow, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty, PostgreSQL, Snowflake and MongoDB Atlas
